perks.name: Balestra
perks.description:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.exact:
Upon damaging an enemy with a Sword, Glaive, or Melee Attack:
Inflicts Exhaustion for 5 seconds, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

perks.name: Stesso Tempo
perks.description: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
perks.exact:
Upon blocking damage with a Glaive or a Sword:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4) for 3 seconds upon no longer guarding. 
Damage Resist can be reset by blocking and dropping the guard before buff expires.
